utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-98-32-T, the Prosecutor versus Mitar Vasiljevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Your Honour, Dermot Groome and Sabine Bauer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you very much. This Status Conference has been called because the Rules of Procedure and Evidence require it to be called within 120 days of the last time the accused was in court. Is there anything either party wishes to raise in accordance with the rule?

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Not from the Prosecution, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. DOMAZET
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, we have no -- we have nothing to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: I rather suspected that would be the case. However, it is always a good idea, even if it's inconvenient to you, Mr. Domazet, to bring you here for the conference so that your client will feel he's still being looked after by somebody. You're both no doubt wondering when the judgement is going to be delivered. I will not give you any promises but I hope it will not be very much longer but you should not expect it before the vacation. With that, we will adjourn.
